combo_label: School Days × Baking & Cakes × Ballet & Dance

entries.clue: Rowdy Parisian high-kicking routine of frilly rustling petticoats
Horse chestnut threaded on string, swung in an autumn duel
Lidded table with an inkwell hole and carved initials
Crumbly, buttery round layered up with summer strawberries
Light, airy cake sharing its name with something found in the bath
Tchaikovsky classic of a cursed princess and her scheming black double
Dark, sticky syrup that gives gingerbread its colour
One who skips lessons and roams the town instead
Lemon's grated yellow in a cake mix, or great enthusiasm
Poised balance on one leg, the other stretched straight out behind
Staying behind after the bell to write lines you will never read again
